reviewer: camera_init independent of source owner player_input_init
classification: Pure evaluation of already collected input snapshot and enabled-state wrapper. This review admits no DirectInput acquisition, device polling, or automatic gameplay.

review.kind1: Full mode emits exactly one down/up entry by current key plus optional current modifier. Edge mode emits current down only when prior state zero and modifier allows, up on current zero/prior nonzero, and no event for held current. Exact current+255/prior+255 aliases preserved; local history read observes earlier kind5 changes.
review.kind2: Actual jump table interleaves positive/negative selectors1..16 for eight axes and1..4 for two mouse axes. Unselected indices contribute zero. Analog sum clips before digital overrides; positive override occurs first, negative last and wins; modifier gates only digital overrides. Final payload binary32. Finite sum intermediate rounding has no distinct clipped binary32 payload.
review.kind3_4: Two16bit raw halves emitted without conversion, pairs3 from originaleed88/eed8a, pairs4 from originaleed80/eed84.
review.kind5: Reverse recent-history match wraps index31; source signed namebyte vs unsigned historybyte is retained; empty names match; success zeroes current head slot and increments head mod32 before later binding evaluation.
review.packet: Analog and pair records emit in binding order, followed by both down/up batches even empty. Each batch padding depends on its own count+2 and explicitly zero-filled in original743ee..74402 and74441..74455 STOS. Source copies only finalat bytes preserving old tail. Packet length/count bytes retain original wrapping.
review.wrapper: Nonzero mode writesflags2 without snapshot evaluation. Zero mode evaluates full state and flags0 on valid nonalias source inputs. Invalid argument/capacity transactional rejection is explicit adapter, not original crash behavior.

validation: Meaningful actual bh_player_input_apply_packet_checked roundtrips all16 joystick and4 mouse selectors, edge/full key branches, modifier/digital priority, both packed pairs, wraparound consuming string history, alias cases, NaN clamp, analog followed by nonempty Boolean batches, wrapper behavior, capacity rejection.
